cases.title: Nuisance-alert suppression
cases.dates: Gates every AEBS approval from 1 Jan 2027
cases.challenge: Four rivals already claim India tuning. India-native is no longer a differentiator. What no competitor has published is a measured nuisance rate — and AIS-162 tests for exactly that.
cases.supply: The denominator rather than the headline: a scenario-stratified false-positive rate per 1,000 km against a named baseline, on the same silicon class, the same functions and the same test set.
steps: Define the India nuisance set — overtaking two-wheelers, cut-in three-wheelers, cattle, roadside encroachment, unlit stationary trucks, wrong-way traffic, kerbside vending
Log every trigger and every non-trigger with scenario tags across three paid pilots, with telemetry rights secured in the contract
Score false positives per 1,000 km and true-positive recall, stratified by scenario, lighting and monsoon
Publish at equal scope; withhold any comparison that silently changes what is being compared

cases.title: Blind-spot and moving-off information
cases.dates: 1 Oct 2027 new models · 1 Jan 2028 all models
cases.challenge: Two-wheeler riders were 46.2% of India’s 1,77,175 road deaths in 2024 and pedestrians 20.6%. AIS-186 demands an information signal 15 m before the expected collision point and forbids manual deactivation.
cases.supply: One India-trained perception core with two output contracts — near-field side and near-field front. Same silicon, same corpus, different detection geometry and signal timing.
steps: Side and front near-field cameras into the module; classify pedestrian, adult cyclist and child cyclist
Project turn geometry including the counter-turn; raise the signal at least 15 m before the collision point and hold it through the manoeuvre
Detect VRUs crossing at 3–5 km/h and cyclists parallel at 0–10 km/h inside the 3.7 m plane; hold through standstill until 15 m past the stopping point
Pass the false-information tests, including the traffic-sign case

cases.title: Driver drowsiness and attention
cases.dates: 1 Oct 2027 new models · 1 Jan 2028 all models
cases.challenge: Approval is not a track test. The manufacturer must run at least ten participants, none from the development team, in day and night, generating ten or more true-positive or false-negative events, and report per-participant sensitivity.
cases.supply: An in-cab drowsiness pipeline delivered together with the study that makes it approvable. The differentiator is not the model — it is handing the integrator a completed documentation package instead of a demonstration.
steps: In-cab infrared camera into the module: eyelid closure, gaze, head pose and PERCLOS-class metrics, working at night
Fuse with vehicle signals — reduced steering micro-corrections paired with larger, faster ones, and lateral lane-position variability
Warn above KSS level 8; escalate visual then acoustic per the HMI specification
Run the ten-participant study and deliver metrics, thresholds, activation speed, weather limits and the statistical analysis

cases.title: Lane departure warning
cases.dates: 1 Oct 2027 new models · 1 Jan 2028 all models
cases.challenge: 58.6% of 2024 road deaths were on national and state highways — about 5% of the network — and 67.6% of accidents happened on straight roads, precisely where LDWS applies. Yet markings on those corridors are worn, inconsistent or absent.
cases.supply: Lane estimation that does not depend on a painted line: road edge, kerb, median, worn marking and vehicle-flow cues fused into a drivable-corridor estimate, with thresholds that move with traffic density and speed.
steps: Segment lane marking, road edge, kerb and median, and estimate marking quality
Estimate the drivable corridor and lateral position when no marking is visible
Modulate the departure threshold by traffic density and speed; suppress during indicated manoeuvres
Emit the departure event with confidence, plus an explicit temporarily-unavailable state

cases.challenge: The shipping product is an FPGA module. Qualified volume silicon lands H1 2028 — after the mandate’s all-models date — and OEM design-in runs 18 to 30 months. Every rupee before H1 2028 has to come from the FPGA module.
cases.supply: The module packaged as a GeM-listed Class-I local-content perception kit for state transport undertakings and PSU fleets, where the gate is eligibility rather than certification.
steps: Compute and document local content at or above 50%, self-certified with the locations of value addition
List on GeM with country of origin and local-content percentage, qualifying for the Make in India filter
Bid into STU, PSU and municipal tenders reserved for or preference-weighted toward Class-I suppliers
Instrument every delivered unit and secure telemetry rights in the supply contract — these units are the evidence engine for UC-02
